verdict.rationale: Fireflies exposes a GraphQL API with transcript/action-item data, webhook support (e.g., transcription-complete webhook) and a Zapier integration that could route data to project trackers, giving an AI agent the technical means to file action items externally. However, there is no evidence of native, first-party integrations or documented automations specifically for Linear, Jira, or Asana — only generic webhook/Zapier plumbing. Missing for 10: dedicated Linear/Jira/Asana connectors or documented API fields for structured action-item export, and independent confirmation that such automations work end-to-end.
